chapters.title: Jonah runs from God
chapters.summary: God sends Jonah to Nineveh, but he boards a ship going the other way. In a great storm the sailors throw him overboard, and a great fish swallows him.

chapters.title: Prayer from the fish
chapters.summary: From inside the fish Jonah prays, remembering how he called to God from the depths. Salvation is of the Lord. The fish spits him onto dry land.

chapters.title: Nineveh repents
chapters.summary: Jonah preaches that Nineveh will be overthrown in forty days. From the king down, the people fast and turn from evil, and God relents.

chapters.title: Jonah's anger
chapters.summary: Jonah is angry that God spared Nineveh. God provides a plant for shade, then takes it away, and asks: should I not pity this great city?
